primary_score: sum of conditional token log-likelihoods over the complete answer-key branch
sensitivity_score: mean conditional token log-likelihood over the same branch

audit.candidate_text: QA scores yes/no keys; MC scores A/B/C/D keys, not option descriptions.
audit.multi_token: Every token in a candidate key is teacher-forced after one shared prompt prefix.
audit.views: The image and no-image views use the same candidate key and normalization.
audit.selection: Sum and mean variants are independently refit and selected on the same 70 paired development examples at the same 4-point CS budget.
